body:
WHAT
Users can configure shell commands (hooks) that run at lifecycle events: SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, PostToolUse and Stop. Each hook gets a JSON payload on stdin. Exit code 0 stdout is fed back to the model as context; exit code 2 means 'block': a blocked PreToolUse stops the tool call, a blocked UserPromptSubmit stops the turn, a blocked Stop makes the model continue with the hook's stderr as the reason.

WHY
Without hooks a project cannot enforce its own gates (linters, policy checks) around the agent; without real blocking a hook's verdict would be advisory only.

WHERE
engine/core/src/agent/hooks.ts — class HookRunner (has(), run(event, payload), summarize() → {blocked, blockReason, contextText}, execOne() with timeout and exitCode 127 on spawn failure), matcherMatches(), DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS. Wiring: engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts — Engine constructor builds HookRunner from settings.hooks and runs SessionStart (contextText → session.addContextMessage). engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts — Session.runTurn() runs UserPromptSubmit (blocked → error event, turn not started) and Stop (blocked → pushes 'Stop hook: <reason>' reminder and continues); Session.executeToolCalls() runs PreToolUse (blocked → isError tool result) and PostToolUse (blocked → appends a system-reminder to the result).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. HookRunner.run('PreToolUse', {tool_name:'Bash', …}) with a matcher 'Bash' spawns the command and delivers the JSON payload on stdin (a hook that echoes stdin yields stdout equal to the payload); a matcher 'Write' does not run it.
2. summarize() over an outcome with exitCode 2 and stderr 'nope' returns {blocked:true, blockReason:'nope'}; over exitCode 0 with stdout 'ctx' returns {blocked:false, contextText:'ctx'}.
3. A hook command that never exits is killed after its timeout and reports {exitCode:null, timedOut:true}; a command that cannot be spawned reports exitCode 127 and never throws.
4. In a Session with a PreToolUse hook that exits 2, a FakeProvider tool call yields a tool_result with isError:true whose content starts with 'PreToolUse hook blocked this call:' and the tool's execute is never invoked.
5. A Stop hook exiting 2 with stderr 'finish tests' makes the session push a user message containing 'Stop hook: finish tests' and request one more model turn; a SessionStart hook's stdout appears as a <system-reminder> context message in the session.
